I'll now implement the Intraday Rotator by modifying `AutoTradingService`. I'll inject `PortfolioService`, add a `rotationTimer` with a one-hour interval, and start it if the market is open. The new `executeRotationRoutine()` will re-scan the market, identify active positions, and then update subscriptions—unsubscribing from symbols no longer in the top picks (provided they have no open positions) and adding new candidates. I'll also update `AutoTradingService` to track its picks and ensure `server.ts` passes the `portfolioService`.
